Use map(), filter() and reduce() with lambda.

Supplied answer
from functools import reduce
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
doubled = list(map(lambda x: x * 2, numbers))
print(doubled) # [2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12]
odds = list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 != 0, numbers))
print(odds) # [1, 3, 5]
total = reduce(lambda a, b: a + b, numbers)
print(total) # 21
Note: map transforms every item, filter keeps some items, reduce combines all into one value.
